Vendored native sources of the :airplay module (screen mirroring).
Generated by tools/airplay/vendor.sh. Do not edit files under third_party/ by hand: change a pin or add a
patch under ../patches/, re-run the script, and check the result with tools/airplay/vendor.sh --verify.
